title: Monster with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#a0ffb0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#40d070'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='30' ry='28' fill='#6ee87f'/>

  <!-- head bumps / ears -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='30' r='9' fill='#5ad86c'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='30' r='9' fill='#5ad86c'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='30' r='9' fill='none' stroke='#9af0a4' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='30' r='9' fill='none' stroke='#9af0a4' stroke-width='2'/>

  <circle cx='41' cy='40' r='8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='40' r='8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='40' r='5.5' fill='#2a6be0'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='40' r='5.5' fill='#2a6be0'/>

  <circle cx='57' cy='37' r='2.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='43.5' cy='43' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61.5' cy='43' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- sparkle stars around eyes -->
  <path d='M30 33 l1.2 2.8 l2.8 1.2 l-2.8 1.2 l-1.2 2.8 l-1.2 -2.8 l-2.8 -1.2 l2.8 -1.2 z' fill='#fff6a0'/>
  <path d='M70 33 l1.2 2.8 l2.8 1.2 l-2.8 1.2 l-1.2 2.8 l-1.2 -2.8 l-2.8 -1.2 l2.8 -1.2 z' fill='#fff6a0'/>
  <path d='M50 22 l1 2.3 l2.3 1 l-2.3 1 l-1 2.3 l-1 -2.3 l-2.3 -1 l2.3 -1 z' fill='#fff6a0'/>
  <!-- mouth with teeth -->
  <path d='M40 54 Q50 64 60 54' fill='#c4306e' stroke='#c4306e' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M40 54 Q50 64 60 54' fill='#c4306e'/>
  <path d='M43 55 l2 3 l2 -3 z' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M49 56 l2 3 l2 -3 z' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M55 55 l2 3 l2 -3 z' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- little arms -->
  <path d='M22 60 Q14 56 12 66 Q16 68 22 66' fill='#5ad86c' stroke='#9af0a4' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M78 60 Q86 56 88 66 Q84 68 78 66' fill='#5ad86c' stroke='#9af0a4' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='88' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#5ad86c'/>

  <circle cx='58' cy='76' r='3' fill='#b8f7c0'/>
